newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Autos head Argentine Oct industrial output rise.
newsitem.headline: Autos head Argentine Oct industrial output rise.

text.p: The auto industry headed Argentina's 12.5 percent increase in industrial production for October, the Economy Ministry said on Monday.
The car industry's output rose 42.6 percent from a year earlier, followed by synthetic and artificial fiber output up 40.3 percent and tyres and fizzy drinks, both at 33 percent.
The biggest falls in production were for yerba mate (tea), down 17.8 percent, basic chemical products, down 14.4 percent, and detergents and soap, down 12.4 percent.
